measurement: The VRTX TX Collar Set is a universal fit device designed for a wide range of patient anatomies. No circumference measurement is required. Height is adjusted using the precision dial: pull out to unlock, turn clockwise to raise the chin piece until it supports the chin, then release to self-lock. Verify fit using the 4-point check: chin plastic flush with tip of chin, head in neutral alignment, collar snug, and airway clear. Must be fitted by a qualified healthcare practitioner. For personalized sizing assistance, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Guarantee .
